intent: A frozen crater lake whose rim breaks away into mist on one side each seed, its ice crossed by the hill-folk's road and split by black leads, with a cathedral of pale ice spires in rings and open courts around a great barrow altar at the nave's end, the wisps rising off its crown.
requests: A cell kind whose lift can vary per cell, so one spire family could be needles of many heights instead of five fixed steps.
A phone budget that scales with map area: ground mist alone is one emitter per ~150 heath cells, so the 40-emitter cap holds any drafted map to roughly moor-sized walkable ground.
